text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (August 13, 2024) for 63 Widdicombe Hill Boulevard.

The Property Standards Committee – Etobicoke York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (August 13, 2024) for 63 Widdicombe Hill Boulevard, Folder Number 24 196274 PRS 00 IV, and in so doing granted an extension to July 31, 2025 to complete the work to the satisfaction of the City.
